title: Senior MEP Project Manager / Contracts Manager
summary: Lead multiple simultaneous MEP construction projects in the Netherlands, taking commercial, financial and operational ownership.
description: Lead multiple simultaneous MEP construction projects in the Netherlands, taking commercial, financial and operational ownership.

sections.heading: Main Duties and Responsibilities
items: Take end-to-end ownership of multiple projects and their commercial, financial and operational performance.
Lead multidisciplinary engineering, commercial and site teams.
Coordinate clients, subcontractors, consultants and stakeholders to deliver milestones.
Maintain safety, quality and regulatory compliance while tracking budgets, KPIs and schedules.

sections.heading: Qualifications and Experience
items: Relevant engineering or technical qualification, preferably mechanical or electrical.
Proven concurrent management of international sites and teams.
Leadership, communication, organisation and cost management skills.
Unrestricted right to work in relevant EU country without sponsorship; valid driving licence.

sections.heading: Key Competencies & Desirable Attributes
items: MEP/data centre background, contract frameworks, risk management, MS Project and document control experience desirable.
